resources.string: Support for APK, APKS, XAPK, and APKM formats. Install split APKs with ease.
Browse installed apps, uninstall unwanted ones, and manage your device effortlessly.
To install packages, the app needs permission to install from unknown sources. Tap the button below to grant it.

Any package you open can be checked against VirusTotal — 70+ antivirus engines — straight from the install screen. Tap \"Check with VirusTotal\" and the result appears before you commit. It needs a free API key: get one below, then paste it into Settings > Advanced > VirusTotal API Key.
If an install fails on MIUI

MIUI/HyperOS optimization can block third-party installs without saying why. If that happens, open Developer options, turn off \"MIUI optimization\", install the app, then turn it back on. While it is off the system theme may look distorted — restarting the phone fixes that.
Notification to return to the app after granting a permission in system settings.
Tap to return to Universal Installer.
